for stage in ['screening','validation']:
 selection=optional(stage+'-selection.json')

  ('scaling','Scaling off / on complete-cost ratios', ['native-w16','native-w32','fp4x2-w16','fp4x2-w32'], ['native / w16','native / w32','FP4 / w16','FP4 / w32'])]:
  lines+=['',title+'; descriptive medians, with all paired values retained.','', '| Family | '+' | '.join(labels)+' |','| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |']
  for family in sorted({r['family'] for r in effects['rows']}):

 lines += [f"Status: **{a['status']}**. {a['complete']} / {a['planned']} sessions; {a['certificates']} / {a['solves']} retained complete-session solves certified. Missing sessions: {len(a['missing'])}.",'',

 c=dense['costs']['fp4x2'];total=c['total_ns']
 lines+=['',f"Coupled-2048 prepared session medians are {dense['native_ms']/1000:.3f} s native and {dense['fp4_ms']/1000:.3f} s FP4, with paired median ratio {dense['ratio']['median']:.4f} and interval [{dense['ratio']['lower']:.4f}, {dense['ratio']['upper']:.4f}]. Both lanes execute 800 physical updates per solve with no observed recovery. FP4 setup and independent checking account for {100*c['setup_ns']/total:.1f}% and {100*c['partitions_ns']['checker']/total:.1f}% of summed complete cost.  lines+=['','Order sensitivity and FP4 cost shares (summed partition time / summed full cost); order-stratum medians are descriptive because eight pairs give no finite interval at the simultaneous threshold.','',
  '| Family | Endpoint | Native-first ratio | FP4-first ratio | Setup % | Independent checking % | Iteration % | Native updates | FP4 updates | Native / FP4 recoveries |',
  '| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- | --- |']
 for r in a['comparisons']:
  c=r['costs']['fp4x2'];total=c['total_ns'];parts=c['partitions_ns']
  check=parts.get('check',parts.get('checker',0));iteration=parts.get('iteration',0)
  lines.append('| '+r['family']+' | '+r['endpoint']+' | '+' | '.join(number(r['orders'][str(order)]['ratio']['median']) for order in [0,1])+f" | {100*c['setup_ns']/total:.1f} | {100*check/total:.1f} | {100*iteration/total:.1f} | "+', '.join(str(x) for x in r['costs']['native']['work'])+' | '+', '.join(str(x) for x in c['work'])+f" | {r['costs']['native']['recoveries']} / {c['recoveries']} |")
else:lines+=['Held-out evaluation has not produced a result. No performance conclusion is claimed.']
samples=[];unavailable=0
for stage in ['screening','validation','holdout']:
 for folder in (BASE/stage).glob('b*'):
  for env in [load(folder/'environment-before.json'),load(folder/'result.json')['environment']]:
   if env['returncode']!=0:unavailable+=1;continue
   sample=list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(env['stdout'])))[1]
   samples.append(dict(driver=sample[1].strip(),temperature=float(sample[2]),memory=float(sample[5].split()[0]),utilization=float(sample[6].split()[0])))
if samples:
 lines+=['',f"All {len(samples)} available before/after block samples use driver {', '.join(sorted({x['driver'] for x in samples}))}; unavailable samples: {unavailable}. The supplemental recovery record preserves that provenance. The first compact archive attempt then failed on an existing catalog (1200 CPU seconds); its initial replay also refused a decoder-window mismatch (240 CPU seconds). Production-stream tests exposed and corrected compressed versus uncompressed ZIP offsets and expanded-size accounting, and the replacement uses a bounded 64 MiB decoder window for its 32 MiB stream. for label,name in [('Admission, including the first partial pilot','serial-admission-v2/result.json'),('Scientific study','serial-study/result.json')]:

 '## Independent resources and disposition','',

lines+=['',f"Total charged: **{sum(cpu.values())/1e9:.9f} CPU / {sum(gpu.values())/1e9:.9f} GPU seconds**, against 112000 / 15500. Includes 512 preparation and 128 closing CPU administration. Historical allocations stay closed; held-out resources did not fund tuning.",'',
 'Four CPU slots, sampled aggregate RSS 16 GiB, owned device buffers at most 12 GiB, one pinned shared host lease and the unchanged one-second supervisor apply. Every >100 ms advisory remains in the receipts. Sampled RSS is not a peak-memory enclosure. Full failed reservations are charged.']

text='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
